description: A Fabric mod that turns Minecraft into a quantum-circuit lab, backed by a real statevector simulator

mods.name: QuantumCraft
mods.description: Teach quantum computing in Minecraft: build real quantum circuits (up to 3 qubits) from Pauli/Hadamard/phase/CNOT/Toffoli gate blocks along qubit timelines, and read out exact amplitudes or a probabilistic measurement, all backed by a genuine complex-amplitude statevector simulator.

releases.notes:
Initial release. A Fabric mod for teaching quantum circuits in Minecraft:

- Qubit Line, Quantum Gate (Pauli X/Y/Z, Hadamard, S, T presets), Control Node, and Target Node
  blocks, laid out along up to three parallel qubit "timeline" rows.
- A Quantum Probe: right-click for an exact ideal readout of every basis state's probability,
  shift-right-click for a genuine Born-rule collapsing measurement.
- A real complex-amplitude statevector simulator underneath (single-qubit gates, general
  controlled-gates, Toffoli, Born-rule measurement), verified against 9 closed-form/statistical
  checks (Bell/GHZ states, Toffoli truth table, phase kickback, 20,000-trial measurement
  statistics, unitarity preservation).
- Five worked experiments (single-qubit superposition, Bell state, phase kickback, GHZ state,
  Toffoli-gate truth table) with a full companion LaTeX paper in `latex/`.

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader >=0.19.3, Fabric API 0.155.2+26.2, Java 25.
